Name: Hockey Fights
Overview: Hockey Fights is, as the title might suggest, a recreation of the most exciting part of a hockey match: the fights! Choosing from one of eight teams, the player must beat the snot out of the opposing player in best-of-three bouts. The player can punch or block both high and low; punching will reduce the player's energy, resulting in less damage, but energy can be recharged by blocking attacks. If three punches in succession connect, a "Jersey" attack will be launched where one player pulls the other's jersey over his face and punches him mercilessly, while the other player must mash buttons to break free. The player earns "Victory Points" for winning fights, which can be spent on ability upgrades for the various teams.
